summary_ja: 包括的手法で、特定の取引相手（銀行・証券会社等の規制対象金融機関等以外）とのレポ・証券貸借・マージン貸付等の対象証券金融取引にボラティリティ調整率の下限を適用する範囲を定める。
summary_en: Minimum haircut floors apply to in-scope securities financing transactions (non-government-collateralized repos, certain securities lending, margin loans, and qualifying netting sets) with counterparties other than regulated financial institutions and other listed entities.

sections_en.第六節 第三款 第七目: Haircut Floors for Repo-Style Transactions and Margin Lending and Similar Overseas Transactions

paragraphs: For the following transactions carried out with specified counterparties by an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach that uses the comprehensive approach (referred to as "in-scope securities financing transactions" in Article 83, paragraph (1) and Article 84, paragraph (1)), the haircut floors (meaning the criteria for determining the transactions for which the credit risk mitigation effect of eligible financial collateral cannot be taken into account; the same applies hereinafter) shall be applied. (i) Repo-style transactions satisfying all of the following requirements: (a) The eligible financial collateral is other than bonds of central governments, etc. (b) Cash collateral has been provided to the counterparty from which securities are borrowed, or securities have been purchased with a resale agreement. (ii) Securities lending and borrowing transactions (excluding those in which cash collateral has been provided to the counterparty) for which the value calculated by the formula listed in Article 83, paragraph (1), item (ii)(b) is positive. (iii) Transactions collateralized by eligible financial collateral (limited to those in which the counterparty provides as collateral to the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach securities purchased with money borrowed from it, and the counterparty is not an individual) whose eligible financial collateral is other than bonds of central governments, etc. (iv) Of the netting sets of repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions under a legally effective bilateral netting contract for which the exposure amount after credit risk mitigation is calculated under the provisions of the preceding Article, the following netting sets (excluding those in which all transactions included relate to cash or bonds of central governments, etc., and those relating to the transactions listed in the preceding item under a legally effective bilateral netting contract with an individual): (a) Netting sets with a positive net cash position. (b) Netting sets for which the value calculated by the formula listed in Article 84, paragraph (1), item (ii) is positive (excluding those falling under (a)).

"Specified counterparties" in the preceding paragraph means persons other than the following. (i) Central governments, etc., local governments in Japan, the Japan Finance Organization for Municipalities, Japanese government-affiliated agencies and public sector entities other than foreign central governments. (ii) Financial institutions (excluding persons listed in Article 1, item (vii)(b)), bank holding companies, foreign banks and foreign companies equivalent to bank holding companies subject to the capital adequacy standards and liquidity standards set by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards, financial instruments business operators, Ultimate Designated Parent Companies and management companies (excluding foreign persons) whose risk weight is provided in Article 31, paragraph (1), foreign securities firms, foreign companies equivalent to Ultimate Designated Parent Companies and management companies (limited to foreign persons) subject to the capital adequacy standards and liquidity standards set by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards, insurance companies and insurance holding companies whose risk weight is provided in Article 31-2, paragraph (1), foreign persons equivalent to insurance companies and foreign persons equivalent to insurance holding companies subject to the capital adequacy standards and liquidity standards set by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards, securities finance companies, money market brokers designated by the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency under Article 1-2, item (iii) of the Order for Enforcement of the Money Lending Business Act, and multilateral development banks not falling under the preceding item. (iii) Central counterparties.
